'''Guo Jingkun''' ({{zh|c=郭景坤|p=Guō Jǐngkūn}}; 21 November 1933 – 17 August 2021) was a Chinese scientist in the fields of [[materials science]] and [[inorganic chemistry]]. He was a member of the Communist Party and an academician of the [[Chinese Academy of Sciences]].<ref>{{cite news|url=https://www.thepaper.cn/newsDetail_forward_14098332 |script-title=zh:痛别！又一巨星陨落 |work=thepaper |date=18 August 2021 |access-date=18 August 2021 |language=zh}}</ref>

== Biography ==
Guo was born in [[Shanghai]], on 21 November 1933, while his [[Ancestral home (Chinese)|ancestral home]] was in [[Xinhui]], [[Guangdong]].<ref>{{cite news|author1=Hou Jingjing ({{lang|zh|侯婧婧}})|url=https://www.163.com/dy/article/GHM4IFRP05129QAF.html |script-title=zh:广东籍中科院院士、化学家郭景坤逝世！曾获国家发明一等奖 |work=163.com |date=18 August 2021 |access-date=18 August 2021 |language=zh}}</ref> After graduating from [[Fudan University]] in 1958, he was despatched to the Shanghai Institute of Ceramics, Chinese Academy of Sciences, where he eventually became director in December 1983. On 17 August 2021, he died in Shanghai, aged 87.<ref>{{cite news|url=https://new.qq.com/omn/20210818/20210818A05UKO00.html |script-title=zh:郭景坤院士在沪逝世，他要用"微弱的光为国家再做点什么" |work=qq.com |date=18 August 2021 |access-date=18 August 2021 |language=zh}}</ref>

== Honours and awards ==
* 1990 Member of the [[International Academy of Ceramics]]
* 1991 Member of the [[Chinese Academy of Sciences]]
* 1997 Member of the Asian and Pacific Academy of Materials Sciences
* 1999 Member of [[The World Academy of Sciences]]
* 2004 Science and Technology Progress Award of the [[Ho Leung Ho Lee Foundation]]
